checks: Actual local snapshots are persisted before one original typed application; no optional cloud keys
Missing native items or groups prevent persistence and application
No service, unready user, mismatched identity or absent catalog can enter the local transaction
Catalog probe initializes class metadata only and never creates an instance
Storage failure prevents native application and keeps profile storage untouched
Bad checksums and incompatible source records fail without clearing prior data
Other identity records and cross-page writes are not overwritten
All original seven presets are required; raw native long text is retained
Typed parse failure and incomplete original application cannot report success; owned stack and buffers restore
UTC date comes from the real supplied clock and rejects invalid dates
